description: Transform a plain text article draft into a professional magazine layout. Open '/home/ga/Documents/article_draft.odt' in LibreOffice Writer. Perform the following formatting: (1) Format the body text (everything after the author name) into two columns with at least 0.2" spacing; the title and author must remain single-column. (2) Enable automatic hyphenation for the body text. (3) Apply a 3-line Drop Cap to the first paragraph of the body text. (4) Set the alignment of all body paragraphs to Justified. (5) Create a pull quote by inserting a Text Box or Frame in the center of the page containing the text 'These tiny ecosystems can lower urban temperatures by up to 4 degrees.' (extracted from the text). Ensure the text wraps around this box (Page Wrap). Save the final document as '/home/ga/Documents/article_layout.odt'.
